description: Extract Instagram profile data as structured JSON (username, displayName, bio, posts, followers, followerExact, following, isVerified, website, gridPosts, highlights). Navigate to instagram.com/username/ first. Returns bio, stats, post grid (up to 12), and story highlights.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_extract_ig_profile
